base_plant: v0.13 positive-volume collar with q classes (0,0,8,8)

kernel.parameter: finite output alphabet Y and nonempty support S_z subseteq Y for each mode z
kernel.probabilities: arbitrary rational values strictly positive on S_z and zero outside, summing to one
kernel.charging: each realized raw output y must remain injectively recoverable from the read transcript; normal information is additionally charged
kernel.safety_quantifier: for every disturbance word and every sensor-output word in support
